chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahboub from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The height of the wall of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was one qamah (stature). So he (peace be upon him and his family) would say to Bilal: 'When the time enters, O Bilal, climb above the wall and raise your voice with the Adhan, for Allah has assigned a wind with the Adhan that raises it to the sky. And indeed, the angels, when they hear the Adhan from the people of the earth, say: 'These are the voices of the community of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) affirming the Oneness of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,' and they seek forgiveness for the community of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) until they finish from that Salat.'

key_terms.بِلَال: Bilal (the companion known for his voice)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Adhan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s specific instruction to Bilal to elevate his voice above the mosque wall, emphasizing the acoustic and spiritual amplification of the Adhan. It underscores the Shia understanding of the Adhan as a celestial event where angels actively listen and intercede for the Ummah, linking the earthly call to heavenly worship.
